ITA-1.9.3.3.1 manaḥ, cetaḥ मनः, चेतः
Mind, psyche
The faculty through which cognitive organs (indriya) connect with the soul (atman). Denotes consciousness.

ITA-3.16.2 cetaḥsthānam चेतःस्थानम्
Seats of consciousness
Body sites which are major seats of vital life force; primarily the heart .

ITA-1.9.3.7.2 cetana-dravyam/ sendriyaḥ चेतन-द्रव्यम्/सेन्द्रियः
Sentient being
Any living, sentient, aware, feeling, animate being; any substance imbued with life (including plants).
